changelog:
fg-micro 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Launches a lightweight, high-frequency Fear & Greed index for real-time sentiment checks.
- Enables x402-authenticated polling with EVM wallet payment—no API keys or accounts required.
- Priced at $0.01 per call, with early adopter and volume-based discount tiers automatically applied.
- Simple integration with example code and detailed usage instructions.
- Optimized for minimal overhead in fast loops or as a low-cost trade gating tool.
summary: Lightweight Fear & Greed index snapshot for high-frequency polling
